It’s also worth noting that Apple still does most of its Apple silicon comparisons to the M1 rather than newer chips like M2 or M3. I’ll let that speak for itself. Air vs Pro: Worth the premium? source_detail.title: MacBook Air
source_detail.summary: The MacBook Air is a line of consumer-oriented high-end notebook computers in the Mac series developed and manufactured by Apple since 2008. It features a thin, light structure in a machined aluminum case and either a 13 or 15 in (330 or 380 mm) screen. The MacBook Air's lower prices relative to the larger, higher performance MacBook Pro made it Apple's entry-level notebook for over a decade since the discontinuation of the original MacBook line in 2012, until the introduction of the MacBook Neo in 2026. == Intel-based == === Unibody (2008–2009) === Steve Jobs introduced the MacBook Air during Apple's keynote address at the 2008 Macworld conference on January 15, 2008. The first MacBook Air had a 13.3-inch (340 mm) screen and was initially promoted as the world's thinnest notebook at 19 mm (0.75 in) (a previous record holder, 2005's Toshiba Portege R200, was 19.8 mm (0.78 in) thick). It featured a custom Intel Merom CPU and Intel GMA GPU which were 40% smaller than the standard chip package. It also featured an anti-glare LED backlit TN 6-bit color panel display, a full-size keyboard, and a large trackpad that responded to multi-touch gestures such as pinching, swiping, and rotating. The MacBook Air was the first subcompact notebook offered by Apple after the 12-inch (300 mm) PowerBook G4 discontinued in 2006. It was also Apple's first computer with an optional solid-state drive. It was the last Mac to use a PATA storage drive. To conserve space, it uses the 1.8 in (46 mm) drive used in the iPod Classic instead of the typical 2.5 in (64 mm) drive. It was Apple's first notebook since the PowerBook 2400c without a built-in removable media drive. To read optical disks, users could either purchase an external USB drive such as Apple's SuperDrive or use the bundled Remote Disc software to access the drive of another computer wirelessly that has the program installed. The MacBook Air also did not include a FireWire port, Ethernet port, line-in, or Kensington Security Slot, which were standard features in most other Apple notebooks at the time. On October 14, 2008, a new model was announced with a low-voltage Penryn processor and Nvidia GeForce graphics. Storage capacity was increased to a 128 GB SSD or a 120 GB HDD, and the micro-DVI video port was replaced by the Mini DisplayPort. The disk drive was also changed from a PATA drive to the faster SATA drive. source_detail.summary: MacBook Pro是蘋果公司於2006年1月開始推出的Mac筆記型電腦系列。它是繼 iMac 之後，蘋果推出的第二款搭載英特爾處理器的 Mac 筆記型電腦，也是 PowerBook G4 產品線的繼任者，它也是MacBook家族中的高端機型，雖然在此之前已有13、15及17英寸版本，但已經停產，只保留14及16英寸的產品。 == 歷史 == 2006年1月11日由蘋果公司時任總裁史蒂夫·賈伯斯在Macworld大會上發布，並於同年2月正式出售。第一代MacBook Pro的外觀與PowerBook G4相似，但其實是用了英特爾酷睿處理器，而不是一貫沿用的PowerPC G4處理器。15英寸的機型於2006年1月發布，而17英寸則於4月發布，兩款機型於同年10月推出酷睿2處理器的更新版本。 第二代機型，採用 「Unibody」 一體成型機身，由一整塊鋁合金加工而成，外殼設計更為錐形，並於2008年10月以出及15英寸的MacBook Pro，及13英寸鋁合金一體式的MacBook一起推出。次年1月推出了17英寸的機型，6月推出內建電池的MacBook Pro系列，包括蘋果公司引入的13英寸機型到這個系列。隨後它更升級至英特爾 Core i5 和 Core i7處理器，並引入 Thunderbolt 技術。 2012年6月的WWDC上，蘋果公司推出了第三代重新設計的15英寸螢幕的MacBook Pro。同時，上一代的13及15英寸一體式的機型也公布了更新，銷售的同時也停產了17英寸的機型。雖然尺寸比上一代更細小，但仍保持一體式的機身設計和風格。MacBook Pro的上代跟下代最大的差異，就是新一代的配備有更高解析度的Retina顯示器、以固態硬碟取代了傳統的機械硬碟，以及取消了光驅。第三代13英寸的MacBook Pro於2012年6月12日推出。 2016年10月，蘋果公司推出第四代全新設計的13英寸以及15英吋的MacBook Pro。擁有更輕薄的「Unibody」 一體式機身設計。共有三種機型：13英寸配備Touch Bar的MacBook source_detail.title: M4 vs M3 and M2: What’s improved with the new Apple Silicon?
source_detail.summary: The new iPad Pro has debuted as Apple’s first device with the M4 chip , jumping up from the M2. How does the latest Apple Silicon improve over its predecessors? Here’s a detailed look at M4 vs M3 and M2 on CPU, GPU, Neural Engine, and more. more… The new iPad Pro has debuted as Apple’s first device with the M4 chip , jumping up from the M2. How does the latest Apple Silicon improve over its predecessors? Here’s a detailed look at M4 vs M3 and M2 on CPU, GPU, Neural Engine, and more. M4 vs M3 and M2: Apple Silicon comparison CPU, GPU, Neural Engine specs Since there’s no iPad with an M3 and no Mac with an M4, there’s a bit of unraveling to understand the differences and improvements between the three most recent Apple Silicon chips. Check out our detailed comparison on the latest devices and below we’ll dig into M4 vs M3 and M2 😁. M4 iPad Pro vs M2 iPad Pro: What’s new and improved? M4 iPad Pro vs M2 iPad Air: Is it worth the extra money? M3 MacBook Pro vs M2: What’s different? M4 vs M3 and M2: Apple Silicon comparison CPU, GPU, Neural Engine specs 8 or 16GB with iPad Pro (24GB likely with future Macs) Up to 24GB (max 16GB with iPad Pro) Up to 2TB with iPad Pro (8TB likely with future Macs) Related: M4 already? Here’s why Apple is abandoning the M3 chip line so fast The overall transistor count has increased to 28 billion for the M4 chip. That’s compared to 25 billion for the M3 and 20 billion for the M2. That’s an impressive 40% increase in just two years. Apple says that the M4 CPU is up to 50% faster than the M2 . However, it hasn’t shared a detailed comparison between the M4 and M3 CPUs. But when looking at what may be early M4 iPad Pro benchmarks , results show a ~3,700 single-core score and ~14,000 multi-core score. That’s compared to an M3 Mac CPU benchmarking at a ~3,100 single-score score and a ~12,000 multi-core score. If accurate that puts the M4 CPU up to 18% faster for single-core performance and up to 21% faster for multi-core performance Apple says the M4 GPU is 4x faster than the M2 . And it says the M3 GPU is up to 1.8x faster than the M2 . cited_sources.title: MacBook Pro
cited_sources.summary: MacBook Pro是蘋果公司於2006年1月開始推出的Mac筆記型電腦系列。它是繼 iMac 之後，蘋果推出的第二款搭載英特爾處理器的 Mac 筆記型電腦，也是 PowerBook G4 產品線的繼任者，它也是MacBook家族中的高端機型，雖然在此之前已有13、15及17英寸版本，但已經停產，只保留14及16英寸的產品。 == 歷史 == 2006年1月11日由蘋果公司時任總裁史蒂夫·賈伯斯在Macworld大會上發布，並於同年2月正式出售。第一代MacBook Pro的外觀與PowerBook G4相似，但其實是用了英特爾酷睿處理器，而不是一貫沿用的PowerPC G4處理器。15英寸的機型於2006年1月發布，而17英寸則於4月發布，兩款機型於同年10月推出酷睿2處理器的更新版本。 第二代機型，採用 「Unibody」 一體成型機身，由一整塊鋁合金加工而成，外殼設計更為錐形，並於2008年10月以出及15英寸的MacBook Pro，及13英寸鋁合金一體式的MacBook一起推出。次年1月推出了17英寸的機型，6月推出內建電池的MacBook Pro系列，包括蘋果公司引入的13英寸機型到這個系列。隨後它更升級至英特爾 Core i5 和 Core i7處理器，並引入 Thunderbolt 技術。 2012年6月的WWDC上，蘋果公司推出了第三代重新設計的15英寸螢幕的MacBook Pro。同時，上一代的13及15英寸一體式的機型也公布了更新，銷售的同時也停產了17英寸的機型。雖然尺寸比上一代更細小，但仍保持一體式的機身設計和風格。MacBook Pro的上代跟下代最大的差異，就是新一代的配備有更高解析度的Retina顯示器、以固態硬碟取代了傳統的機械硬碟，以及取消了光驅。第三代13英寸的MacBook Pro於2012年6月12日推出。 2016年10月，蘋果公司推出第四代全新設計的13英寸以及15英吋的MacBook Pro。擁有更輕薄的「Unibody」 一體式機身設計。共有三種機型：13英寸配備Touch Bar的MacBook Pro, 13英寸不配備Touch Bar的MacBook Pro，15英寸配備Touch Bar的MacBook Pro。與上一代的差異是：配備具有P3色域的Retina顯示器、配備替代功能鍵列的Touch Bar、整合Touch ID的指紋感測器、除了3.5mm耳機介面以外，該代機型取消了其他傳統介面、Force Touch觸控板面積相比上代大幅度增加、配備4個支援Thunderbolt 3的USB Type-C介面以及配備第二代蝶式結構鍵盤。 2019年11月，蘋果公司推出重新設計的16英寸的MacBook Pro，同時取代了15英寸機型。尺寸與2015年代15英寸產品相似，加大了16英寸Retina顯示器，加厚了0.03吋，鍵盤上方的多點觸控OLED帶代替了功能鍵；在輕觸條的右端有一個分離的Touch ID感測器（電源按鈕），在觸摸條的左端有一個分離的「esc」鍵。鍵盤則為與「Magic Keyboard」 相似的剪刀式結構鍵盤，取代了之前有爭議的蝶式鍵盤。2020年11月，基於蘋果自研的Apple M1的MacBook Pro 13英寸機型發佈。 2021年10月，蘋果公司推出第五代全新設計的14和16英吋的MacBook Pro，並搭載M1 Pro或M1 Max Apple Silicon處理器，機身尺寸與前代13英吋、16英吋的機型類似，但大幅縮減邊框的寬度，使這代MacBook Pro擁有更高的螢幕占比，並支援 ProMotion 自適應重新整理頻率技術。。這代MacBook Pro的連接方式較前代也有大幅改善，機身不再只提供USB-C連接埠3.5 mm耳機孔之外，該代機型還重新加入了此前被取消的 MagSafe 充電介面（MagSafe 3）、HDMI 埠和 It featured a custom Intel Merom CPU and Intel GMA GPU which were 40% smaller than the standard chip package. The MacBook Air was the first subcompact notebook offered by Apple after the 12-inch (300 mm) PowerBook G4 discontinued in 2006. It was also Apple's first computer with an optional solid-state drive. It was Apple's first notebook since the PowerBook 2400c without a built-in removable media drive.
